newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT - Indian GDRs edge up on political hopes.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT - Indian GDRs edge up on political hopes.

text.p: Indian global depositary receipts posted mild gains in a slow market on Tuesday as a local market holiday dampened trade, dealers said.
But they said hope for a resolution to the country's political crisis had underpinned sentiment and gains could be expected in Bombay on Wednesday.

India's ruling United Front coalition said it would hold talks with the Congress Party on Wednesday, raising hopes of a resolution to the crisis sparked by the Congress Party's decision to withdraw support 10 days ago.
Prime Minister H.D. Deve Gowda's coalition faces a confidence vote on April 11, and analysts said a political resolution would settle nerves about the passage of the investor-friendly 1997/8 budget.
Key prices were firmer, SBI adding 18 cents to $20.00/$20.50 and VSNL up 10 cents at $17.15/65.
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index closed 0.63 points, or 0.87 percent, down at 72.59 points, with the premium over the local market at 19.24 percent from 18.26 percent on Monday.
Taiwanese GDRs jumped amid continued volatility in the local market, which eased on Tuesday after four days of gains.
The Capel Taiwan GDR Index ended 5.53 points up at a new year high of 139.08, swinging to a premium of 3.58 percent from a 2.73 percent discount.
The Capel Korea GDR Index ended 1.79 points, or 2.83 percent, up at 64.99, a premium of 29.56 percent over the local market.
